name: J. N. Maxwell
role: Northern Pacific and express agent at Medora, 1884-86
bio: J. N. Maxwell came to Medora in November 1884 from the car accountant's office at Mandan, trading places with agent Fegan to become the Northern Pacific agent. In December 1884 he was also made agent for two rival express companies, including Wells, Fargo & Co. Through 1885 his name ran as agent at the foot of the Northern Pacific time table printed in the paper. In September 1885 the paper announced his marriage. In January 1886 he was to serve temporarily as Wells-Fargo agent at Billings before going to St. Paul, and by February 1886 he was an express messenger on the Jamestown Northern road between Jamestown and Minnewaukon.
